plugins.description: Personal skills: pr-review (machine facts first, then the repo's own rules and a per-repo review profile, then one risk-first reading of the diff, then a skeptic per finding, then a decider per open question so the user is asked only what truly needs them), and pr-review-loop (fix, prove and re-review until the review is green).
